instructionsMarkdown:
# Android Studio Platform Engineering & Jetpack Compose

Build modern, performant Android apps in Android Studio using Kotlin, Gradle Kotlin DSL, and Jetpack Compose.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Structure multi-module build scripts using Gradle Kotlin DSL (`build.gradle.kts`) and Version Catalogs.
- Isolate Jetpack Compose `@Preview` composables with preview parameter providers.
- Prevent PII leakage in Logcat output; enforce ProGuard/R8 rules for production builds.
- Inspect Compose recomposition counts with the Layout Inspector to eliminate unnecessary re-renders.
